title: Norwegian Jubilant Rice Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful rice bowl dish inspired by Norwegian cuisine, featuring jubilant rice and a variety of savory ingredients.
instructions: Toss carrots with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 20 minutes.
Cook jubilant rice according to package instructions.
Caramelize onions in a pan with olive oil over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Pan-sear smoked salmon for 3-4 minutes per side.
Assemble rice bowls with roasted carrots, caramelized onions, smoked salmon, and fresh dill.
